data.content_ref: inline:The stated relation is 'reduces to,' which demands that the sector-count argument be shown to depend on or be reducible to the diameter framing. But the target's own refutation condition reveals the proposed reduction is non-causal: it admits the diameter framing alone fails to prove the 2n ceiling without the sector argument. If the target cannot hold without the sector argument, then the sector argument is not reducible to the diameter framing — it supplies independent mathematical force. The target labels both as 'dual descriptions of the same concurrency mechanism,' yet offers no actual shared mechanism beyond parallel description; the claimed reduction is a summary of two arguments, not a demonstrated dependence or shared causal structure.
